name: zdeck-public-stack
description: Public Z-Deck firmware layer for LilyGO T-Deck/T-Deck Plus on Meshtastic 2.8. Adds the Z-Deck identity/version surface, GPS/compass refresh fixes, map/cache status, clearer message delivery labels, hop counters where packet route data exposes them, SD message journal support, SD prepare/reset tools, screen correction tools, serial recovery, and a public on-device health panel.

targetDevice.sdCard: Supported for maps, local message journal, ringtone storage, logs, and prepare/reset setup; USB mass storage is disabled in this public build to keep serial stable.

build.status: WSL build completed successfully. This public build bumps the runtime to zdeck4 / 0.2.3-public, disables always-on USB SD mass storage for serial stability, keeps SD prepare/reset tools, SD message journaling, hop/status message labels, corrected I2S RTTTL ringtone playback, and LongFast-only defaults.

publicSetup.notes: Users can add their own channels, PSKs, owner names, and admin configuration after flashing with the Meshtastic app or CLI. No private channel data is shipped.
